projects.name: Restitch
projects.oneLiner: Thrift-flip planner — the photo names the shape, you bring the tape.
projects.audience: Thrifters who want to flip a piece, sewing machine or not
projects.pays: Free now. A $19/yr Plus plan is an untested idea.
projects.summary: Restitch does not generate a pattern. Upload a photo and the page reads average color, brightness, and aspect from that file, then offers no-sew, hand, and machine flips for the skill you pick. Body numbers are what you type. The closet stays in this browser. No account, no checkout, no pattern PDF.
projects.latest: Plan this make runs on this site. A different photo is a different read. Measurements and saved flips stay in the browser.

plan.title: Plan this make
plan.lede: Upload the garment. Restitch reads average color, brightness, and aspect from that file and writes flips for the skill you pick. You type the tape. A visual guess stays labeled. There is no pattern PDF.
plan.disclaimer: Restitch wrote these steps from the photo you uploaded and the skill you picked. Measurements are the ones you typed. A visual guess is not a size. Technique links leave this page. This is not a pattern.

photo.alt: Stand-in line drawing of a sleeveless top with a wide neckline and a straight hem, laid flat beside a US letter sheet.
photo.caption: The before image is the photo you upload. Restitch does not substitute a drawing.
photo.secondUpload: A second photo runs. It is a new read, not this one again.

measurements.label: You measured these
measurements.note: Stand-in numbers until Alexandra measures a real top. The drawing did not produce them.

read.title: Read
read.body: Sleeveless woven top. Wide neckline. No zipper in the photo. Straight hem. Fabric guess: midweight woven. Confidence is “from this photo,” and the back is marked unknown.

measureNext.title: Measure next
measureNext.body: The four numbers above are stand-ins for what you would type. They are not a finished size. Still take this tape list — the photo fixed the shape and the tape fixes the size. This page does not print centimeters from the photo.

make.title: Make plan
steps: Compare a free tank’s finished bust to the flat bust of this shirt times two.
Lengthen or shorten at the marked line.
Lower or raise the neckline on the pattern, then cut a muslin and check the armhole and the neckline gap.
Sew shoulders, attach a neck facing, sew the sides, hem.

projects.name: Skill Quest
projects.oneLiner: A game that teaches beginners to build AI skills: quests, scored skill cards, weekly battles.
projects.audience: Beginners building their first Claude skills
projects.pays: Sponsored battles, Pro at $8/mo, Teams at $20/seat.
projects.summary: Quests walk beginners through building real Claude skills. Every skill gets tested on hidden tasks against plain Claude by a blind judge and becomes a shareable card (Power, Lift, Clarity, Speed, Finds it), and battles put skills head to head. Anthropic already scores skills; Skill Quest makes it fun for beginners. Money plan: sponsored battles, then Pro at $8/mo, then Teams at $20/seat.
projects.latest: The scorer works: built as a Claude Code plugin (score, battle, five quests) and run on a real skill, idea-innovate scored Epic 81 (won 1, tied 1, lost 1 vs plain Claude). Not published yet; the name is taken, so it needs a new one first.

housekeeping.visualsHome: content/portfolio.json → projects[].visuals (one cell per column). Live URLs go in visuals.*.url. Screenshots/stills go in media/ when ready.
housekeeping.nonVisualHome: General = skills, agents, reusable craft. Per-project Code = repo links + short summaries. Longer plans/docs stay in the Project store docs/ — not on the public grid.
housekeeping.retireOld: Old shapes removed: freeform surfaces[], Ads/Waitlists/Landings lenses. To drop something: delete its cell content or set state to na, remove dead links, rebuild + republish. Never reintroduce removed projects.

updateHint: Edit content/portfolio.json. Fill visuals.<column>.url for live demos. Keep non-visual in general + projects[].code. Then rebuild and republish.
